metadata.description: Humanness measurement baseline for the deterministic PR gate (measurement-loop spec tasks 1-4). `expected` is seeded from the first local run of scripts/run_humanness_deterministic.py; thresholds are conservative margins to catch real regressions without firing on normal variance.
metadata.note: Only axes with real evaluated data (n>0) on the synthetic set are gated. `anti_ai` (the structural shape AI-tell classifier) is the load-bearing deterministic signal. `relationship`/`fidelity` are NOT gated here: they need a target register/persona absent from the synthetic set (n=0), so they belong to the scheduled secrets/persona tier (spec tasks 5-6). A metric with no signal must not appear in a gate as a vacuous always-0.0.

anti_ai.description: Structural shape classifier: higher = more human (fewer AI-tell patterns). Deterministic, offline, secret-free. Regression = current < 0.8875 - 0.05.

aggregate.description: Mean of the gated deterministic metrics (currently anti_ai alone). Regression = current < 0.8875 - 0.05.
